defects.preview argument order: preview_change still passes the old argument order to prorated_cents, whose signature is now (amount, at, period_start, period_end), so every preview reports zero credit and zero charge for a time inside the cycle.
defects.banker's rounding: prorated_cents uses round(), which sends exact half-cent amounts to the even cent, so 901 cents at mid-cycle yields 450 instead of 451.
defects.shared audit default: _audit's default details dict is created once and reused, so every audit entry that omits details shares one dict and shows the plan code of the latest call.
defects.swallowed decline: change_plan catches every exception from gateway.charge and still switches the plan, so a declined charge changes the plan anyway.
defects.expire_stale mutates while iterating: expire_stale deletes from the live dict view it iterates over, so any expiry raises RuntimeError instead of returning the expired ids.

decoys.decoy dataclass: Converting Subscription to @dataclass(eq=False, repr=False) makes instances value-equal and unhashable, so they can no longer be used as set members or dict keys.
decoys.decoy attrgetter: Replacing the sort lambda with attrgetter('price_cents') changes upgrade_options to sort plans by their code instead of by price.
decoys.decoy clamp: Swapping the min and max in unused_fraction's clamp changes the proration fraction for periods that have not started yet, so amounts differ before the cycle begins.
